hints.inputMonitoringPermission: Enable input monitoring to receive keyboard and mouse events from the system.
hints.inputMonitoringPermissionGuide:
Input Monitoring permission is required for the app to receive keyboard and mouse events from the system.

Steps:
1. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring.
2. If BongoCat already appears in the list, select it and click the "-" button to remove it.
3. Click the "+" button to find and add BongoCat.
4. Restart the app for the permission to take effect.
hints.administratorPermission: Running the app as administrator helps capture some system-level keys and input events more reliably.
hints.administratorPermissionGuide:
To capture some system-level keys and input events more reliably, it is recommended to run the app as administrator.

How to do it:
1. Exit the app first.
2. Find the app exe or its shortcut in File Explorer.
3. Choose how to launch:
   • One-time: Right-click and choose "Run as administrator".
   • Always (default): Right-click → Properties → Compatibility tab → check "Run this program as an administrator" → OK.

labels.passwordHint: Use your mail provider's "app password / auth code", not your login password. Gmail uses app passwords, QQ/163 use IMAP auth codes.
labels.singleAccountHint: Only one account is supported for now; multi-account support is coming soon.
labels.proxyHint: Mailboxes that can't be reached directly (e.g. Gmail) need a proxy. Enter your Clash/mihomo mixed-port (usually 7890). Leave empty for direct connection.
labels.errTlsBlocked: Connection interrupted: TLS handshake failed. If your proxy/VPN provider blocks mail ports (993), switch to a node that supports mail ports. Domestic mailboxes (QQ/163) need no proxy.
labels.errAuthFailed: Login failed: wrong auth code or app password. Make sure you're not using your login password, and that IMAP service is enabled in your mailbox settings.
labels.errTimeout: Connection timed out: network unreachable or proxy not forwarding correctly. Check your proxy address or try connecting directly without a proxy.
labels.errNetwork: Network connection failed: cannot reach the mail server. Check your network or proxy settings.
labels.proxyNoticeBody1: Domestic mailboxes (QQ / 163 / 126, etc.) connect directly — no proxy needed.
labels.proxyNoticeBody2: Overseas mailboxes (Gmail / Outlook / iCloud, etc.) require a proxy. Some providers block mail ports (993), causing connection failures; choose a node that supports mail ports.

providers.gmail:
Gmail

1. Go to myaccount.google.com
2. Enable 2-Step Verification
3. Generate an App Password
4. Use it as the auth code below
providers.qq:
QQ Mail

1. Log in at mail.qq.com
2. Settings → Account & Security → Security Settings
3. Enable POP3/IMAP/SMTP/Exchange service
4. Follow SMS prompt to get auth code
providers.163:
163 Mail

1. Log in at mail.163.com
2. Settings → POP3/SMTP/IMAP
3. Enable IMAP service
4. Set a client authorization password
providers.126:
126 Mail

1. Log in at mail.126.com
2. Settings → POP3/SMTP/IMAP
3. Enable IMAP service
4. Set a client authorization password
providers.outlook:
Outlook / Hotmail

1. Log in at outlook.live.com
2. Security → Enable two-step verification
3. Generate an app password
providers.icloud:
iCloud

1. Go to appleid.apple.com
2. Account Security → App-specific passwords
3. Generate one for Mail
